Montreal Communique 


Vv 


March 30th, 1971. 


Students who are prepared to work without pay for one week 
on a road gang are being offered an opportunity to take part in 


a Canada-Guyana exchange program July 15 - August 12. 


Out-of-pocket cost per participant will be between $200 and 
$350, depending on whether looked-for support is received from 


the Federal Secretary of State. 


The project, sponsored by the Montreal YMCA, is designed 
to promote two-way understanding and appreciation of the 
cultural, social, economic, political and geographical 


differences between Guyana and Canada. 


The exchange starts July 15th, when a group of young adults 
from Guyana is scheduled to arrive in Montreal for a two-week 
stay with their Canadian counterparts. Together, they will 


travel to Guyana July 29th. 


The program in Guyana includes visits to key areas and a 
seven-day labor stint on the 800-mile Lethem Road being con- 


structed to link up with the Pan Am Highway in Brazil. 


Deadline for applications is April 30th. For complete 
information, please contact Wilf Allan of the Montreal YMCA 
at 849-5331.
